description: Source code for FreeType's path stroker, including bezier computations, stroke border management, and stroker creation and configuration.

classes.name: FT_StrokerRec
classes.description: Main stroker object managing stroke parameters, borders, and state.

classes.name: FT_StrokeBorderRec_
classes.description: Represents a stroke border with points, tags, and state.

methods.name: FT_Outline_GetInsideBorder
methods.description: Returns the inside border of an outline based on its orientation.

methods.name: FT_Outline_GetOutsideBorder
methods.description: Returns the outside border of an outline based on its orientation.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_Set
methods.description: Configures the stroker with radius, line cap, join, and miter limit.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_Done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the stroker.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_grow
methods.description: Grows the border's point and tag arrays to accommodate new points.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_close
methods.description: Closes a sub-path in the border, optionally reversing it.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_lineto
methods.description: Adds a line segment to the border.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_conicto
methods.description: Adds a conic (quadratic) Bezier segment to the border.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_cubicto
methods.description: Adds a cubic Bezier segment to the border.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_arcto
methods.description: Creates an arc segment in the border.

methods.name: ft_stroke_border_moveto
methods.description: Starts a new sub-path in the border.
